description: Implement a trie that supports insertion, exact-word counts, prefix counts, and erasing one copy of an inserted word. Example 1: after inserting apple, search counts apple once, app zero times, and the app prefix once; after inserting app and erasing it, app's exact count is zero. Example 2: inserting the same word twice and erasing it once leaves one copy. Constraints: words contain lowercase English letters and erase is called for a word present in the trie.
intuition: Trie nodes share common prefixes, while counters distinguish how many inserted words pass through or end at each node.

brute_force.approach: Store every word in a list and scan the list for exact and prefix counts.
brute_force.time: insert O(1), erase/count O(total stored characters)

optimal.approach: Store child links, a pass count, and an ending count at each trie node.

edge_cases: Repeated insertions increase both path and terminal counts.
Erasing one copy must not remove other copies of the same word.
